question: The Nagara and Dravida are architectural styles related with ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**temples**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In Dravidian Style

 
 
• **In Dravidian Style,** it is generally a solitary pinnacle.
 
• Sanctuaries situated in Northern India are recorded in** Nagara style.**
 
• Sanctuaries situated in Southern India are recorded in** Dravida style. Dravida style has one single shikhara.**
 
 
 
• **Nagara Style of Architecture**
 
 
• The is more than one Shikhara in these sanctuaries.
 
• There are various pinnacles in this sanctuary.
 
 
 
• **Dravidian Style of Architecture**
 
 
• This sanctuary has just a single Shikhara.
 
• There is just a solitary pinnacle in this sanctuary.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Gurudwara

 
 
• **Sherdil Singh Sandhu, president, of Gurudwara Master Singh Sabha,** said they will permit individuals from all religions to involve in the premises for petitions.
 
 
 
• **Churches**
 
 
• The word church is gotten from Early English service, "spot of gathering put away for Christian love", from the Proto-Germanic kirik.
 
 
 
• **Masjid**
 
 
• Arabic masjid is any house or open area of supplication **in Islam.**
 
 
 
• Vesara style
 
 
• **Vesara style** of design prospered in the Deccan part of India. Additionally called the Hybridized style, it consolidates highlights of Nagara and Dravida styles.
